title: Surreal Green Smile
description: A dark surreal scene shows a pale woman with elaborate black hair sitting on a green patterned couch, holding a small black and tan dachshund while a brown boxer rests beside her. In the center, a large glowing green smiley face with black eyes floats above a reflective dark liquid floor. To the right, a creepy broken doll-like figure with glowing green eyes sits against a graffiti-covered wall. Three colorful stylized female faces with swirling hair float in the background.
prompt: Surreal dark scene of a pale gothic woman with swirling black hair sitting on a green patterned couch petting a dachshund and a boxer dog. A large glowing neon green smiley face with dripping black eyes floats in the center above a reflective black floor. To the right a creepy pale broken doll with green eyes sits against a wall covered in graffiti and smiley faces. Three colorful female faces with pink, green and purple swirling hair float in the background, swirling patterns and liquid floor, eerie atmosphere.
